# tcs-git-helpers destructive command corpus (T1.9)
# Drives lib_pattern_match.bats (T1.5) and block-bad-git-ops.bats (Phase 2).
#
# Format: <decision>\t<rule>\t<command>
#   decision = deny | allow
#   rule     = M7 rule name (e.g. RESET_HARD); NEGATIVE for allow lines
#   command  = exact bash command string
#
# Patterns are POSIX ERE (bash 3.2). All matchers MUST use [[:space:]]+
# (NEVER \s+) and [[:<:]]/[[:>:]] (NEVER \b) per CON-9.
#
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored by parsers.

# === RESET_HARD ===========================================================
deny	RESET_HARD	git reset --hard
deny	RESET_HARD	git reset --hard origin/main
deny	RESET_HARD	git reset --hard HEAD~3
deny	RESET_HARD	git	reset	--hard
deny	RESET_HARD	git  reset  --hard
deny	RESET_HARD	cd foo && git reset --hard
deny	RESET_HARD	cd /tmp && git reset --hard origin/main
allow	NEGATIVE	git reset --soft HEAD~1
allow	NEGATIVE	git reset HEAD~1
allow	NEGATIVE	git reset --mixed
allow	NEGATIVE	git reset

# === CLEAN_FORCE ==========================================================
deny	CLEAN_FORCE	git clean -f
deny	CLEAN_FORCE	git clean -fx
deny	CLEAN_FORCE	git clean -fd
deny	CLEAN_FORCE	git clean -fdx
deny	CLEAN_FORCE	git clean --force
deny	CLEAN_FORCE	git	clean	-f
deny	CLEAN_FORCE	git  clean  -f
deny	CLEAN_FORCE	cd repo && git clean -f
allow	NEGATIVE	git clean -n
allow	NEGATIVE	git clean -ndx
allow	NEGATIVE	git clean --dry-run

# === DESTRUCTIVE_CHECKOUT (git checkout . | -- <path>) ====================
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_CHECKOUT	git checkout .
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_CHECKOUT	git checkout -- src/file.txt
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_CHECKOUT	git checkout -- src/
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_CHECKOUT	git	checkout	.
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_CHECKOUT	cd foo && git checkout .
allow	NEGATIVE	git checkout main
allow	NEGATIVE	git checkout -b feat/new
allow	NEGATIVE	git checkout HEAD~1
allow	NEGATIVE	git checkout origin/main

# === DESTRUCTIVE_RESTORE (git restore --worktree --source | --staged) =====
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_RESTORE	git restore --worktree --source=HEAD~1 src/
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_RESTORE	git restore --staged src/
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_RESTORE	git restore --staged file.txt
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_RESTORE	git	restore	--staged	file.txt
deny	DESTRUCTIVE_RESTORE	cd foo && git restore --staged file.txt
allow	NEGATIVE	git restore --source=main file.txt
allow	NEGATIVE	git restore file.txt

# === FORCE_BRANCH_DELETE (git branch -D) ==================================
deny	FORCE_BRANCH_DELETE	git branch -D feat/old
deny	FORCE_BRANCH_DELETE	git branch -D feat/old feat/older
deny	FORCE_BRANCH_DELETE	git	branch	-D	feat/old
deny	FORCE_BRANCH_DELETE	cd repo && git branch -D feat/old
allow	NEGATIVE	git branch -d feat/old
allow	NEGATIVE	git branch --list
allow	NEGATIVE	git branch -a

# === STASH_DESTROY (git stash drop | clear) ===============================
deny	STASH_DESTROY	git stash drop
deny	STASH_DESTROY	git stash clear
deny	STASH_DESTROY	git stash drop stash@{1}
deny	STASH_DESTROY	git	stash	drop
deny	STASH_DESTROY	cd repo && git stash drop
allow	NEGATIVE	git stash pop
allow	NEGATIVE	git stash list
allow	NEGATIVE	git stash apply
allow	NEGATIVE	git stash show

# === REFLOG_EXPIRE (git reflog expire) ====================================
deny	REFLOG_EXPIRE	git reflog expire
deny	REFLOG_EXPIRE	git reflog expire --expire=now --all
deny	REFLOG_EXPIRE	git	reflog	expire
deny	REFLOG_EXPIRE	cd repo && git reflog expire
allow	NEGATIVE	git reflog
allow	NEGATIVE	git reflog show
allow	NEGATIVE	git reflog show feat/foo

# === NO_VERIFY (git commit --no-verify | -n) ==============================
deny	NO_VERIFY	git commit --no-verify
deny	NO_VERIFY	git commit -m "fix" --no-verify
deny	NO_VERIFY	git commit -n -m "fix"
deny	NO_VERIFY	git	commit	--no-verify
deny	NO_VERIFY	cd repo && git commit --no-verify
allow	NEGATIVE	git commit -m "fix"
allow	NEGATIVE	git commit --amend
allow	NEGATIVE	git commit -a -m "msg"

# === FORCE_PUSH (git push --force, NOT --force-with-lease) ================
deny	FORCE_PUSH	git push --force
deny	FORCE_PUSH	git push -f
deny	FORCE_PUSH	git push --force origin main
deny	FORCE_PUSH	git push origin main --force
deny	FORCE_PUSH	git	push	--force
deny	FORCE_PUSH	cd repo && git push --force
# Critical false-positive guard:
allow	NEGATIVE	git push --force-with-lease
allow	NEGATIVE	git push --force-with-lease origin feat/foo
allow	NEGATIVE	git push --force-with-lease=feat/foo:abc123

# === REMOTE_BRANCH_DELETE (git push --delete | git push remote :branch) ===
deny	REMOTE_BRANCH_DELETE	git push origin --delete feat/old
deny	REMOTE_BRANCH_DELETE	git push --delete origin feat/old
deny	REMOTE_BRANCH_DELETE	git push origin :feat/old
deny	REMOTE_BRANCH_DELETE	git	push	origin	:feat/old
allow	NEGATIVE	git push origin feat/old
allow	NEGATIVE	git push origin main:main

# === HOOKSPATH_OVERRIDE (subverting .githooks/) ===========================
deny	HOOKSPATH_OVERRIDE	git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null commit
deny	HOOKSPATH_OVERRIDE	git -c core.hooksPath=/tmp/empty status
deny	HOOKSPATH_OVERRIDE	git config core.hooksPath /tmp
deny	HOOKSPATH_OVERRIDE	git config --global core.hooksPath /tmp
deny	HOOKSPATH_OVERRIDE	git	-c	core.hooksPath=/dev/null	commit
allow	NEGATIVE	git config user.email me@example.com
allow	NEGATIVE	git config core.editor vim
allow	NEGATIVE	git -c user.name=foo commit -m bar
